places.reason: Google: "If you omit the field mask, the method returns an error." There is no default list of fields. These defaults ask only for fields of the Essentials, IDs Only and Pro SKUs, plus nextPageToken for text search paging; Enterprise fields (rating, phone numbers, opening hours, website, price level) cost more and are asked for by name in field_mask.

streetviewpublish.source: https://developers.google.com/streetview/publish/first-app ("After you have your API key and access token"; the samples send both ?key=YOUR_API_KEY and authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN). Every method of the API lists the OAuth scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/streetviewpublish in Discovery.
streetviewpublish.reason: gsearch and gmaps are the apikey group: gmaps holds an API key and has no Google sign-in, so no OAuth token is ever sent. Every Street View Publish tool is expected to be refused until the product gains an OAuth sign-in, which is a separate decision (adversarial review of gmaps, F2).
